description: Refused the name, wrote it, and scraped it off. He did not speak.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Found the shilling between the box and the stair, and put the correction on the line.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Put the shilling on the line. The leaf is yours.
name: John Heminges

description: Brought the clerk's question in, and swore to the hurry.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Held the candle. He did not speak.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Said it in good faith, and was told to keep the manners.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Said he was equally wronged, and said the twelve days where Kemp did not hear them.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Paid the share with the name. Not in the house.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.
name: William Shakespeare
